ns2:course.label: Industrial Design II
ns2:course.description: Studio design problems of increasing complexity involving structures and mechanisms. Lectures and discussions to explore design issues affecting contemporary culture and aesthetics perceptions. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing in Industrial Design major. Class Materials Fee of $35 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term. Prerequisite: ARTD 201. Concurrent registration in ARTD 224 or ARTD 225.
